name: GeoToolbox
summary: Determine place descriptor information for map coordinates.

declarations.name: PlaceDescriptor
declarations.comment: Contains representations of a physical place, suitable for searching or retrieving rich data.

members.name: commonName
members.comment:
Publicly known name of the area or place of interest.
Locations that do not have a public name (like a private residence) should be nil.
e.g. "Starbucks" or "Yosemite National Park"

members.name: coordinate
members.comment: The latitude and longitude for a place.
members.typescript: get coordinate(): ({ latitude: number; longitude: number }) | null

members.name: description
init
members.comment:
Creates a PlaceDescriptor, suitable for searching or retrieving rich data about a place.

Representations must have at least one member.
Arrays should be sorted with original and/or most accurate representations first.

- Parameters:
  - representations: A list of ways to reference the place using common mapping concepts.
  - commonName: Publicly known name of the area or place of interest. e.g. "Starbucks"
  - supportingRepresentations: List of ways to represent a place that are proprietary or non-uniform
members.typescript: static init(representations: Array<PlaceDescriptor_PlaceRepresentation>, commonName?: (string) | null, supportingRepresentations?: Array<PlaceDescriptor_SupportingPlaceRepresentation>): PlaceDescriptor

members.name: representations
members.comment:
An array of representations of the place using common mapping concepts

When searching or fetching a place from a mapping service provider,
the order of the list can be used as a hint. Representations that
most closely match the original data source come first.

For example a hike tracking app may include a `.coordinate` first, even
if an approximate `.address` is available. A contacts application may put
`.address` first, even if a `.coordinate` has been fetched for display on a Map.

members.name: serviceIdentifier
members.comment: Retrieve the identifier for a given service provider, if available.

members.name: supportingRepresentations
members.comment:
An array of proprietary or non-uniform representations of the place.
If understood by the consumer, these can be used in place of or in addition to common representations.

members.name: address
members.comment: Full address, as would be used in postal or administrative scenarios.

declarations.name: PlaceDescriptor.PlaceRepresentation
declarations.comment: Representation of a physical place using well known attributes

declarations.name: PlaceDescriptor.SupportingPlaceRepresentation
declarations.comment: Representation of a physical place using proprietary or non-uniform attributes
